# SkillHealth
**English** | 中文
SkillHealth is a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that records skill invocations and answers three ques
tions: is a skill actually used, how well does it perform, and should the library be tidied up?
## Features
- **One event stream across hosts** — DSH `tools/execute` and Claude Code `PreToolUse/PostToolUse` h

ooks append to the same JSONL file
- **Pairing and de-duplication** — `session_id + tool_use_id`, fa

lling back to `skill + 60s` when no tool id exists
- **Rebuildable SQLite artifacts** — delete `inde

x.sqlite3` / `rollup.sqlite3`; both are rebuilt from `events/`
- **Health diagnostics** — six rules

plus a weighted score (coverage / success / freshness / redundancy)
- **Restrained reminders** — ter

minal line, native notification, and in-app popup; at most once per session, with ignore/dismiss
- *
*Standard opt-out** — reads and writes the Agent Skills `disable-model-invocation` frontmatter field
- **Management page** — advice, all skills, and trend views with search, detail expansion, and defa

ult-load switches
- **Local by design** — metadata only, no remote upload
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Install the cloned directory as a DSH bundle:

- use Plugin Manager → install from a local directory, or
- ask the agent to call `plugin_manager` w
ith `action: install_bundle` and the absolute path as `target`
Restart the host after installing so the Host module loads; refresh the Client page after client cha
nges. The default data root is `~/.agents/_skill-usage-stats`.
## Data layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Deleting `index.sqlite3` / `rollup.sqlite3` only loses cache; deleting `events/` is the real data lo
ss. Filter by host with `SELECT ... WHERE agent = ?`; no separate databases are needed.
## Event contract
`src/core/event.mjs` owns the field set; facades may only produce events through `makeEvent()`:

- Required: `id ts schema agent skill trigger phase session_id cwd via status`
- Optional: `tool_use

_id prompt_hash duration_ms error_code agent_version`
- `phase ∈ {start, end}`; `start` is always `p

ending`; `end` is `ok|error|abort`
- Unknown fields throw, so no host can add a field behind another

host's back
- `id` is derived from `agent + session_id + (tool_use_id | skill+second) + phase`, so
replay is idempotent
Host differences stay in `src/adapters/`:
| Adapter | Entry point | `via` |

| `dsh.mjs` | `tools/execute` around the real `skill` tool dispatch | `tool-event` |
| `claude-code.
mjs` | `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse` hooks via `bin/collect.mjs` | `hook` |
`test/adapter-parity.test.mjs` asserts both adapters produce the same field set and covers unknown f
ields, invalid phase/status, and deterministic ids.
## Pairing
Merge key = `session_id + tool_use_id`; without a tool id it degrades to `skill + 60s` window.

- No end after 30 minutes → the start is marked `abort` (killed process / user interruption)
- An or

phan start younger than 30 minutes stays `pending` and is resolved by a later rebuild
- An end with

no start is written to `collector.log`
- Duplicate events are de-duplicated by `id`
## Aggregate tables
`index.sqlite3`: `calls` (paired results), `event_seen` (idempotence), `meta`.
`rollup.sqlite3`:
| Table | Primary key | Purpose |

| `rollup_daily` | day, agent, skill | trend, ranking, p50/p95 |
| `skill_meta` | skill | first/last

use, install path, description fingerprint |
| `cooccur` | session_id, skill_a, skill_b | same-sess

ion co-occurrence |
| `health_snapshot` | scanned_at | score, four dimensions, issue JSON |
The UI never scans all JSONL: the popup and `/skillhealth` read `health.json` + `rollup`; the weekly
report reads only the last 7 days of `rollup_daily`.
## Health rules
Six rules; each hit produces one issue:
| Rule | Condition | Suggested action |

| Never used | installed > 30 days and 0 calls | archive |
| Stale | last use > 60 days and < 3 call

s total | archive |
| Duplicate | description similarity ≥ 0.8 and same category | merge |
| Broken

path | SKILL.md or a relative dependency is missing | fix / delete |
| High failure | ≥ 10 calls and

failure rate > 15% | investigate |
| Trigger conflict | keyword overlap and ≥ 3 same-session co-occ
urrences | rewrite description |

Health score = coverage 35% + success 25% + freshness 25% + redundancy 15%, each dimension 0–100.
“C
ategory” comes from the skill source (project / user / runtime / bundled / custom). Trigger conflict
is a keyword-overlap + co-occurrence heuristic; it does not read the model's real routing.
## Reminders
Triggered when health < 75 or issues ≥ 10, outside a silence window. Reminders stop automatically on
ce health returns to 80+, and the weekly report records the recovery.
All three channels share one message:

- Terminal: one stderr line on the first turn, never added to model context
- Native notification: m

acOS `osascript`; Linux `notify-send`; failures only go to `collector.log`
- In-app popup: `shell.ov

erlay` card, at most 3 suggested skills, selectable for disabling
- Management page: sidebar `SkillH
ealth` icon opens a `main` panel with advice, all skills, and trend views
Restraint:

1. At most one reminder per session; `notify.json` records reminded sessions
2. “Ignore this week” s

ilences for 14 days; “Close” disables the current rule class, weekly reports continue
3. Health ≥ 80
stops reminders automatically; native notifications have a 24-hour cooldown
## Default loading and disabling
The “default load” switch reads and writes the standard Agent Skills field in `SKILL.md`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `true`: DSH's skill provider sets `modelInvocable` to false; the model catalog and `skill` tool no

longer expose it
- Users can still invoke it explicitly with `/your-skill` (`user-invocable` defaul

ts to true)
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy
- Metadata only: skill name, duration, status, cwd, and the first 8 hex characters of a prompt sha1

- No prompts, responses, or file contents are stored
- `$HOME` in cwd is folded to `~`
- Nothing is
uploaded; native notifications stay local
